verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google Ads needs immediate structural review.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Meta brought in all 138 leads at a cost of $15.79 per lead, and the pace is picking up — the last three days averaged 7.3 leads per day versus 5.3 the three days prior. Google Ads spent $506.90 over the same window and produced zero conversions; this is a structural issue with how the campaign is set up or tracked, not a temporary dip, and it is being investigated now. Separately, 134 leads have entered your pipeline this period but none have moved to an appointment or a won opportunity, which means the follow-up process inside your CRM is where attention is needed most. Work is underway to close the setup gaps that are blocking the full system from running end-to-end. Next period you should expect clearer conversion visibility on Google and a push to get leads moving through the pipeline.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta
cost per lead on Meta, stable and efficient
spent on Google Ads this period with zero conversions returned

watch_item.issue: 134 leads entered your pipeline this period and none converted to an appointment or a closed opportunity — leads are stalling after they arrive.
watch_item.fix: The CRM build and end-to-end stack are being completed and tested so that leads move through the follow-up sequence automatically rather than sitting idle.
